description: This file defines Vulkan driver data structures, function prototypes, and handle management for the Android Vulkan implementation, including instance and device data, external function declarations, and internal utility templates.

classes.name: InstanceData
classes.description: Holds Vulkan instance-specific data including dispatch table, layer info, and debug callback.

classes.name: DeviceData
classes.description: Holds Vulkan device-specific data including dispatch table, extension hooks, and debug callbacks.

methods.name: OpenHAL
methods.description: Initializes the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) for Vulkan.

methods.name: GetDefaultAllocator
methods.description: Returns the default Vulkan allocation callbacks.

methods.name: QueryPresentationProperties
methods.description: Queries presentation properties for a physical device.

methods.name: GetAndroidNativeBufferSpecVersion9Support
methods.description: Checks support for Android native buffer spec version 9.

methods.name: GetInstanceProcAddr
methods.description: Retrieves function pointers for instance-level Vulkan functions.

methods.name: GetDeviceProcAddr
methods.description: Retrieves function pointers for device-level Vulkan functions.

methods.name: EnumeratePhysicalDevices
methods.description: Enumerates physical devices available to the Vulkan instance.

methods.name: GetDeviceQueue2
methods.description: Retrieves a device queue with extended info.

methods.name: QueueSubmit
methods.description: Submits command buffers to a queue.

methods.name: GetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties2
methods.description: Retrieves format properties for a physical device.
